## Validation Summary
10 files created (JavaScript, JSON, YAML); 4/4 tasks completed; COMPILATION and CODE_REVIEW gates passed with 1 issue caught and resolved.

## Issues Detected

**Non-deterministic sort order under identical timestamps** — `src/routes/todos.js`, `GET /todos` sort comparator — Severity: LOW
- **What:** Sort comparator `new Date(b.createdAt) - new Date(a.createdAt)` produced undefined ordering when two records share the same millisecond timestamp, violating the "newest first" contract.
- **Where:** `src/routes/todos.js`, `GET /todos` route handler.
- **Why:** `INCOMPLETE_IMPLEMENTATION` — sort logic lacked a tiebreaker for equal-timestamp cases.
- **Fix:** Insertion-order tiebreaker (`todos.indexOf(b) - todos.indexOf(a)`) appended to comparator; later-inserted items now consistently sort first on timestamp collision.

## Checks Passed
Compilation (JS/JSON/YAML), static review, route wiring validation, import path resolution, all 5 endpoints verified (POST, GET /, GET /:id, PATCH /:id, DELETE /:id), UUID usage, input validation, unknown-field rejection, in-memory store exports, test suite imports, 13/13 tests passing, README present, PORT env var support

## Bottom Line
1 issue was caught and resolved by automated checks before merge.
